 [REPLAY] Ian Charles & Doc O’Connor – Investing in Sports Teams at Arctos Sports Partners (Capital Allocators, EP.225) Feb 10, 2025

 Ian Charles and Doc O’Connor are the Co-Founders and Managing
Partners of Arctos Sports Partners, a private equity firm dedicated
to buying minority stakes in professional sports franchises. From
its founding just two years ago, Arctos quickly has become the
market leader in the space, raising a $2.1 billion first-time fund
and a SPAC alongside Executive-in-Residence Theo Epstein, and
buying stakes in MLB teams including the Boston Red Sox, the Golden
State Warriors and Sacramento Kings in the NBA, and a compliment of
other sports assets.

 
 Our conversation covers their backgrounds and the formation of
Arctos, the investment opportunity in sports franchises, and the
underlying business and ownership structure. We then turn to the
unique characteristics look of the asset, investment process, and
growth strategy. 
   
 Full disclosure, I am a personal investor in Arctos’ fund and
am a fan of their strategy and team, pun intended. I hope you’ll
enjoy this conversation with Doc O’Connor and Ian Charles as much
as I did.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
